content.headline: Jun got a shot approved while Bea lost an umbrella
content.introduction: Jun started a new job at an animation studio in Toronto while Marisol baked conchas in Mexico City. Priya spent time at the hospital with her grandmother in Bengaluru as Ana worked at a hackathon in Vancouver.

member_updates.headline: Ana built a newspaper app at HackCamp
member_updates.text: Ana spent her weekend at HackCamp at UBC, building a little newspaper for the group. She reported that the team had good pizza, had not slept much, and successfully got login working at two in the morning.

member_updates.headline: Bea bought a raincoat after losing an umbrella
member_updates.text: Bea spent four days in the rain and watched her second umbrella invert and fly into the Thames on Waterloo Bridge. She later bought a raincoat with a hood, which she felt officially made her a Londoner, and booked a flight home landing December 18.

member_updates.headline: Jun got his first animation shot approved
member_updates.text: Jun started at an animation studio, securing a desk next to the window after spending four hours learning how the render farm works. He redid a three-second walk cycle four times until his lead said the weight shift looked right. Next Friday, he plans to pitch a short film idea about a lighthouse keeper who collects lost umbrellas.

member_updates.headline: Marisol perfected her abuela's concha recipe
member_updates.text: Marisol tried baking her abuela's concha recipe, but her first attempt came out flat, "like pancakes with a sugar hat." After learning from her mom that the dough had risen in a cold kitchen, her second batch turned out perfect, and the extras were gone within an hour at the lab. She is now preparing for a thesis committee meeting on Wednesday.

member_updates.headline: Priya cared for her grandmother in Bengaluru
member_updates.text: Priya took turns staying at the hospital after her grandmother was admitted on Monday night with breathing problems. Her grandmother is now resting back home though still weak, and Priya expressed gratitude for the supportive messages while asking for calls on Sunday morning her time.

little_victories.headline: Jun's first shot approved
little_victories.text: Jun redid a three-second walk cycle four times before his lead approved the shot.

little_victories.headline: Marisol baked perfect conchas
little_victories.text: Marisol's second batch of conchas came out perfect and vanished quickly at her lab.

little_victories.headline: Ana got login working late
little_victories.text: Ana and her team got login working at two in the morning during HackCamp.

looking_ahead.headline: Bea landing home on December 18
looking_ahead.text: Bea booked her flight home, landing on December 18.

looking_ahead.headline: Jun pitching short film idea
looking_ahead.text: Jun will pitch a short film about a lighthouse keeper who collects lost umbrellas next Friday.

looking_ahead.headline: Marisol's thesis committee meeting
looking_ahead.text: Marisol has a thesis committee meeting on Wednesday to discuss chapter three.

looking_ahead.headline: Priya asking for weekend calls
looking_ahead.text: Priya requested a call on Sunday morning her time.
